description: Run on a PE primary to begin graceful removal of a compiler's ICA by moving it from active to draining. Proxy compilers exclude a draining ICA from their pool; follow with peadm::decommission_ica_compiler to complete removal

fqdn.description: FQDN of the compiler whose ICA should be drained

token.description: RBAC token for a user holding the certificate_authority:sign_ica permission. The drain endpoint does not accept the primary's agent certificate alone.
